DOGE miner Z Squared is going public through a merger with Coeptis. The deal will close in Q3 2025, making it one of the largest publicly traded Dogecoin mining firms. Big moves for $DOGE mining.

#Dogecoin #CryptoNews https://t.co/uTPNjF80ET

The SEC has delayed its decision on Bitwise’s spot Dogecoin ETF, setting a new deadline of June 15, 2025. This move aligns with expectations, as final deadlines for most filings are anticipated in October or later .
